name: Sea Level Rise Explorer Ventura, CA
summary:
Ventura’s coastline is changing. Sea level rise and stronger storms are reshaping familiar places. The
choices made today will determine what endures for the next generation.
This virtual reality experience lets you see those changes up close. Explore the Ventura Fairgrounds,
Pierpont, the Ventura Keys, and the shoreline as flooding, erosion, and rising seas affect the places you
know. Then see what is possible: vegetated dunes, nature-based buffers, elevated and floodproofed
